about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a software engineer building high-performance web apps using JavaScript, Python, Express.js, Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Sql, Docker, Tailwind CSS, GitHub, and Figma. I am a polymath with a passion for building scalable solutions and solving complex problems.

items.title: PIIFILL
items.description: A high-performance CLI tool that works 100% offline to mask sensitive data (PII) in server logs, JSON, SQL dumps, and visual files.

items.title: JAWAB - Realtime Chatbot
items.description: Conversational search engine that crawls websites, indexes content, and answers queries using AI.

items.title: Secure Blog Backend API
items.description: Secure REST API with JWT and OTP authentication, supporting blogs, comments, and social features.

items.title: AI Resume Builder
items.description: AI-powered resume builder with authentication, DOCX export, and editable templates.

items.title: RedisOS — Redis Playground
items.description: A hands-on playground designed for developers to master Redis concepts through practical execution.

items.title: Git Visual Flow
items.description: An interactive web tool that visualizes Git branching strategies and commands in real-time with smooth animations.

items.title: SDE Intern
items.description: Collaborated cross-functionally with development teams to design, implement, and deploy scalable internal solutions. Optimized website and application performance.

items.title: UI/UX Designer
items.description: Designed and prototyped the complete company website for InfoOcean, focusing on modern UI, seamless user experience, and responsive design systems.

items.title: Graphic Designer
items.description: Developed visual assets and marketing collateral, focusing on impactful storytelling through digital design and community outreach materials.
